scenarios.attack_description: Attacker or bit-rot flips 1 bit in a stored content chunk
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect corruption and identify exact chunk hash
scenarios.detection_mechanism: SHA-256 chunk hash comparison during full verification
scenarios.notes: Pinpoints exact chunk hash mismatch with non-zero exit code.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker deletes a chunk file from storage
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect missing chunk and name chunk hash
scenarios.notes: Detected immediately in both quick and full modes.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker deletes intermediate snapshot 1 to purge historical records
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect deletion via hash chain gap and witness DB cross-check
scenarios.detection_mechanism: validate_chain cross-check with witness DB records
scenarios.notes: Missing manifest in repo recorded in witness DB is detected as chain_broken.

scenarios.threat_capability: Rolls back to an older snapshot
scenarios.attack_description: Attacker reverts repository head from snapshot #3 back to snapshot #2
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect rollback via sequence head discrepancy against witness DB
scenarios.detection_mechanism: validate_chain checks repo head seq against witness DB latest sequence
scenarios.notes: Caught because witness DB head (seq 3) is ahead of repository head (seq 2).

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker alters file metadata in manifest JSON without valid Ed25519 signature
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect invalid cryptographic signature and hash mismatch
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Ed25519 signature verification and manifest hash comparison
scenarios.notes: Signature verification fails immediately upon inspecting manifest.

scenarios.attack_description: Compromised backup server updates chunk and internal hashes but lacks signing key
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect signature failure and mismatch against witness DB
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Ed25519 signature verification against pinned public key
scenarios.notes: Even if all internal hashes are self-consistent, signature verification fails.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker signs forged manifest with an unauthorized key on compromised server
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect signature invalidity with pinned key and manifest mismatch with witness DB
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Pinned public key verification and witness DB hash matching
scenarios.notes: Independent witness DB prevents server from masquerading altered history.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker uses stolen private key to sign an injected malicious snapshot in repo
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect untracked manifest not present in independent witness DB
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Witness DB cross-check detects repo snapshot missing from witness ledger (file_added finding)
scenarios.notes: Detected as file_added / untracked manifest by witness DB cross-check. Known limit: if stolen key is used during authorized schedule, cryptographic signature verifies.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker injects an unauthorized manifest row into SQLite witness DB
scenarios.detection_mechanism: HMAC-SHA256 row MAC verification flags row tampering (manifest_modified finding)
scenarios.notes: Row MAC check flags tamper before any snapshot processing occurs.

scenarios.attack_description: Ransomware encrypts client files into high-entropy blobs with .locked extension
scenarios.target_outcome: Heuristic detection of entropy anomaly, extension changes, and change spike
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Ransomware heuristics (entropy jump, extension change, change spike)
scenarios.notes: Cryptographic hash verify alone MISSES this (hashes match corrupted data). Ransomware heuristics catch the transition.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker modifies external anchor proof BLOB in witness database
scenarios.target_outcome: Detect anchor verification mismatch against backend attestation
scenarios.detection_mechanism: verify_anchors checks backend attestation against proof and batch root
scenarios.notes: Detected as anchor_mismatch due to invalid proof bytes.

scenarios.attack_description: Attacker gains root/admin on verifier host and patches binary to return exit code 0
scenarios.target_outcome: Out of scope for software tamper-evidence; requires operational isolation
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Out of scope (requires air-gapped / dedicated separate verifier host)
scenarios.notes: Software cannot verify itself on a compromised host. Mitigated by hosting verifier on an independent machine with read-only backup credentials.

scenarios.attack_description: Storage drive experiences total hardware failure or unrecoverable sector loss
scenarios.target_outcome: Out of scope for integrity verifier; requires multi-site redundancy
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Out of scope (requires hardware RAID / offsite replication)
scenarios.notes: Tamper-evidence detects alteration and corruption; it does not replace redundancy. Requires 3-2-1 backup strategy.
